# TechTarget

> TechTarget is a global network of IT and healthcare technology websites providing enterprise news, expert analysis, and practical guidance on AI, cybersecurity, data management, and digital health innovations.

TechTarget serves IT professionals, healthcare organizations, and business leaders with curated content spanning enterprise software, emerging technologies, and industry-specific solutions. The platform combines breaking news, technical definitions, and expert contributor insights across multiple specialized verticals.

## Key Topics

- Artificial Intelligence (AI)
- Cybersecurity
- Data Management & Orchestration
- Enterprise Software
- Healthcare Technology
- Digital Health & Telehealth
- IoT (Internet of Things)
- Business Intelligence & Analytics
- Cloud Computing
- Data Security & Compliance
- AI Drug Discovery
- Revenue Cycle Management
- Sustainability & ESG
- Mobile Device Management
- Patient Engagement

## News & Updates

- [TechTarget Enterprise Technology News](https://www.techtarget.com/news): Enterprise tech news covering AI, cybersecurity, data orchestration, and industry trends.
- [TechTarget - Global Network of Information Technology Websites and Contributors](https://www.techtarget.com): TechTarget homepage: global IT news, enterprise software, AI, cybersecurity.

## Healthcare Technology

- [Healthcare Analytics Information, News and Tips](https://www.techtarget.com/healthtechanalytics): Healthcare analytics: AI adoption, data governance, predictive analytics.
- [Healthtech Security Information, News and Tips](https://www.techtarget.com/healthtechsecurity): Healthcare security: HIPAA compliance, cybersecurity, data protection.
- [Healthcare Payers Information, News and Tips](https://www.techtarget.com/healthcarepayers): Healthcare payers news: Medicare, Medicaid, claims management.
- [Virtual healthcare information, news and tips](https://www.techtarget.com/virtualhealthcare): Virtual healthcare: telehealth, remote monitoring, digital health.
- [Patient Engagement Information, News and Tips](https://www.techtarget.com/patientengagement): Patient engagement: AI chatbots, digital health, healthcare innovation.
- [Revenue Cycle Management Information, News and Tips](https://www.techtarget.com/revcyclemanagement): Revenue cycle management: claims, reimbursement, AI healthcare.
- [Pharma and Life Sciences Information, News and Tips](https://www.techtarget.com/pharmalifesciences): Pharma news: drug development, clinical trials, AI drug discovery.

## Emerging Technologies
